stories.title: Ontario Catholic teachers vote strongly in favour of strike mandate
stories.summary: The union representing Catholic teachers says educators are dealing with chronic classroom underfunding by the Ford government.

stories.title: Infant among 3 dead in Burlington townhouse fire
stories.summary: Officials confirmed Monday that an adult male, a 12-year-old child and a one-year-old baby have died. An adult female and one other child remain in critical condition.

stories.title: Canada’s Alert Ready emergency system will test notifications on Wednesday
stories.summary: The emergency alerts are used by governments to inform the public of emergencies including tornadoes, floods, wildfires and Amber Alerts

stories.title: Mississauga’s data centre moratorium facing challenge from American company
stories.summary: An American-based logistics company is looking to overturn the municipality's one-year moratorium on artificial intelligence data centres.

stories.title: Barnes: Raptors need ‘uncomfortable conversations’
stories.summary: Scottie Barnes is ready to have some hard conversations about how the Toronto Raptors perform under pressure.

stories.title: Brunson, Towns power Knicks past Raptors 112-108
stories.summary: Jalen Brunson drilled a three-pointer with 33.4 seconds left in overtime as the New York Knicks rallied to a 112-108 win over the Toronto Raptors on Sunday.

stories.title: Lehkonen, Blackwood lead Avalanche past Canadiens
stories.summary: Artturi Lehkonen had a goal and an assist to help the short-handed Colorado Avalanche beat the Montreal Canadiens 4-1 without injured stars Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar on Saturday night.

stories.title: Avalanche stars MacKinnon, Makar to miss weeks
stories.summary: The Colorado Avalanche will have to make do without their two biggest stars in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Ex-Durham police recruit pleads guilty in sex assault case involving 2 teen girls
stories.summary: William Knight, 33, pleaded guilty to two counts of sexual assault and one count of making child pornography in a downtown courtroom Friday.

stories.title: Stelco to recall 175 laid-off workers in Hamilton, Ont. on Dec. 1
stories.summary: Stelco is recalling 175 temporarily laid off workers as it plans to restart its Hamilton, Ont., finishing operations on Dec. 1.
